entries.title: Genesis 14:1
segments: And it happened in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations,

entries.title: Genesis 14:2
segments: they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

entries.title: Genesis 14:3
segments: All these were joined together in the valley of Siddim, which is the Salt Sea.

entries.title: Genesis 14:4
segments: They served Chedorlaomer twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

entries.title: Genesis 14:5
segments: And in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him came and struck the giants in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

entries.title: Genesis 14:6
segments: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, as far as the oak of Paran, which is [by] the wilderness.

entries.title: Genesis 14:7
segments: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.

entries.title: Genesis 14:8
segments: And the king of Sodom went out, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboim, and the king of Bela (which [is] Zoar). And they joined battle with them in the valley of Siddim;

entries.title: Genesis 14:9
segments: with Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal the king of nations, and Amraphel the king of Shinar, and Arioch the king of Ellasar, four kings with five.

entries.title: Genesis 14:10
segments: And the valley of Siddim [was] full of asphalt pits. And the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

entries.title: Genesis 14:11
segments: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

entries.title: Genesis 14:12
segments: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who lived in Sodom, and all his goods, and went away.

entries.title: Genesis 14:13
segments: And there came one who had escaped. And he told Abram the Hebrew, for he lived in the plains of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. And these had a covenant with Abram.

entries.title: Genesis 14:14
segments: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he led forth his trained servants, born in his own house (three hundred and eighteen) and pursued them to Dan.

entries.title: Genesis 14:15
segments: And he divided himself against them by night, he and his servants. And he struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which [is] on the left of Damascus.

entries.title: Genesis 14:16
segments: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

entries.title: Genesis 14:17
segments: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and of the kings with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which [is] the king's valley.

entries.title: Genesis 14:18
segments: And Melchizedek the king of Salem brought forth bread and wine. And he [was] the priest of the most high God.

entries.title: Genesis 14:19
segments: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed [be] Abram of the most high God, possessor of Heaven and earth.

entries.title: Genesis 14:20
segments: And blessed [be] the most high God, who has delivered your enemies into your hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

entries.title: Genesis 14:21
segments: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the people and take the goods for yourself.

entries.title: Genesis 14:22
segments: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of Heaven and earth,

entries.title: Genesis 14:23
segments: that I will take from all that is yours, [not] from a thread even to a shoestring, lest you say, I have made Abram rich.

entries.title: Genesis 14:24
segments: Nothing for me, only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
